card.name: Supportive care in overdose sections
card.fires_on: The word "supportive" in overdose-management text, as in "employ the usual supportive measures" or "treatment is supportive". It also fires on a few other words in the same overdose setting, such as "HOURS" in an observation period and "copious" before irrigation.

modes.label: Supportive measures
modes.description: The word "supportive" after employ, provide or treatment is, in overdose instructions.
modes.example: In the event of an overdose with INPEFA, contact the Poison Control Center. Employ the usual<< supportive>> measures as dictated by the patient's clinical

modes.label: Other overdose-care words
modes.description: Words ending a phrase about observation time or first-aid washing in exposure text.
modes.example: POSSIBLE MOTOFEN ® OVERDOSAGES AS SERIOUS AND MAINTAIN MEDICAL OBSERVATION FOR AT LEAST 48 H<<OURS>>, PREFERABLY UNDER CONTINU

card.writes: It pushes toward injury-related words such as injured, injuries and concussion, with no clear link to the suppressed tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "supportive" when an overdose section says to give general supportive care.
